The name "Hang Khoai" originated from the various types of sweet potatoes sold by merchants in the past. Midway along the street, at number 54, stands the ancient Huyen Thien temple, also known as the Huyen Thien shrine, which venerates Huyen Thien Tran Vu, commonly referred to as "the saint," originally worshipped at the Quan Than temple.
